entries.93ba3c4ec51dcb88: It makes electrified vehicles such as Outlander PHEV, SUVs and pickup trucks such as Triton and Pajero Sport, passenger cars and minivans such as Mirage and Delica D:5, kei cars such as Delica Mini, and genuine parts. entries.97c8fa7090e1b2c1: The group consists of MITSUBISHI MOTORS CORPORATION, 35 consolidated subsidiaries and 16 affiliates accounted for by the equity method (as of March 31, 2026). It develops, produces and sells automobiles and their parts, and conducts sales financing and leasing, with development led mainly by MITSUBISHI MOTORS CORPORATION. The number of employees is 27,695, of which 27,483 are in the Automotive Business and 212 in the Financial Services Business (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.9b3b7997d268ceaa: Electrified vehicles (Outlander PHEV, eK Cross EV, Minicab EV, etc.)
entries.a3b5ae6a28bf24d5: This business develops, manufactures and sells automobiles and their parts. In Japan, the company manufactures ordinary and small passenger cars and kei cars, which are sold by product sales companies such as Higashi-Nihon Mitsubishi Motors Sales Co., Ltd. and Nishi-Nihon Mitsubishi Motors Sales Co., Ltd. Overseas, Mitsubishi Motors (Thailand) Co., Ltd. (Thailand) and others handle production and sales, and PT Mitsubishi Motors Krama Yudha Indonesia (Indonesia) and others handle production. Development is led by the company, with Mitsubishi Motors Engineering Corporation handling part of development, and Mitsubishi Motors Logitechno Co., Ltd. handling the sale of genuine parts, new-vehicle inspection and maintenance, and parts logistics.
